sources.fuel_price_usd_per_t: VLSFO, 13 Nov 2026: Rotterdam ~720-745 USD/t, Singapore ~820-880 USD/t (Ship & Bunker, OilPriceAPI). Prices fell ~20% in early November, so this moves fast.
sources.co2_t_per_t_fuel: IMO default CO2 factor for low-sulphur fuel oil.
sources.canals.base_toll_usd: Toll for a reference ship, multiplied by the ship's toll_factor (data/ships.json). Suez: ~0.8-1.2M USD for a 15,000 TEU ship; the SCA's 15% rebate for large container ships ended on 7 Apr 2026. Panama: 2025 tariff ~300k USD fixed + 35-45 USD/TEU. Rough estimates, not official tariffs.
sources.canals.waiting_days: Planning assumption for queueing and transit time; it is charged as extra charter days.
sources.war_risk_premium_pct: % of hull value per transit. Charged for these chokepoints on every route that passes them (current market), plus any chokepoint the agent flags as high-risk (at the default rate). July 2026: Bab el-Mandeb 0.5-2%, Hormuz 3-10% (0.25% before the conflict) (Al Jazeera, Reuters).
sources.eu_ets: Since 2026, 100% of CO2 is covered for voyages between two EU ports and 50% for voyages to or from the EU. EUA ~87 EUR/t (Nov 2026), converted at ~1.15 USD/EUR.
sources.ships.json: Container charter rates are based on HARPEX, Sep 2026 (2,500 TEU ~37k, 4,250 TEU ~59k USD/day). Other ship figures are rough planning values for a school project.
